records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Lantern Works!
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Your workspace for Lantern Works is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Next step for Lantern Works
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks for the note back, and sorry again about the logout trouble earlier in the week — that ticket is closed on our end, so do flag it if it ever returns.

With your first project up, the usual next step is getting your team in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through getting Lantern Works' real work into Wrenfield with you.

Best,
Nadia
